description: Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android & iOS Application TCP and UDP traffic

# ProxyBridge

 

ProxyBridge is a free, open-source proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for **Windows**, **macOS**, **Linux**, **iOS** and **Android**. It forces the applications you choose to use a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy for their TCP and UDP traffic, even apps with no proxy settings or that ignore them, with no changes to the app. > [!TIP] > **ProxyBridge routes your traffic - [InterceptSuite](https://interceptsuite.com) lets you see inside it.** > Full MITM proxy with SSL/TLS inspection, live request editing, scripting, and support for TCP, UDP, StartTLS, DTLS, QUIC and more. Built by the same team. [**Try InterceptSuite →**](https://interceptsuite.com) ## Table of Contents - [Download](#download) - [Features](#features) - [Screenshots](#screenshots) - [Inspect redirected traffic with InterceptSuite](#inspect-redirected-traffic-with-interceptsuite) - [License](#license) - [Author](#author) - [Credits](#credits)

💖 Support ProxyBridge Development
If you find ProxyBridge useful, consider sponsoring to support ongoing development and new features!

## Download

Download ProxyBridge
Windows x64 · macOS (x64 & arm64) · Linux (x64 & ARM64)

The Android app is in closed testing on Google Play. To get access, join the [ProxyBridge testers group](https://groups.google.com/g/proxybridge-testers) with the Google account you use on your phone, then install the app from Google Play. You can also build it from source, see [Android](Android/README.md). The iOS app is still in testing, so there is no public release for it yet. You can build it from source, see [iOS](iOS/README.md).

Older versions

> [!CAUTION] > **Beware of fake ProxyBridge downloads.** Some unofficial sites distribute malware under the ProxyBridge name. Download only from this repository or [interceptsuite.com/download/proxybridge](https://proxybridge.interceptsuite.com/download/), or build from source. ProxyBridge contacts no server except its update feed (`download.interceptsuite.com/proxybridge.json`), on launch or when you check for updates. ## Features - **Per-process routing** - send traffic from chosen applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, or direct, or block it - **Works with proxy-unaware apps** - system-level interception, no changes to the application - **TCP and UDP** - HTTP/HTTPS, HTTP/3, SSH, RDP, databases, games, DTLS, DNS and more - **Flexible rules** - match processes, IPs, ports, protocols and host names, with wildcards and IPv4/IPv6 - **GUI and CLI** on Windows, macOS and Linux, with profiles and rule import/export - **iOS and Android apps** - route a phone's traffic through a proxy by destination: domain, IP or CIDR, port and protocol ## Screenshots - [macOS screenshots](MacOS/README.md#overview) - [Windows screenshots](Windows/README.md#usage) - [Linux screenshots](Linux/README.md#gui-application) - [iOS screenshots](iOS/README.md#screenshots) - [Android screenshots](Android/README.md#screenshots) ## Inspect redirected traffic with InterceptSuite **[InterceptSuite](https://interceptsuite.com)** is a cross-platform MITM proxy for inspecting, intercepting, and modifying network traffic. Use ProxyBridge to redirect application or system traffic to InterceptSuite's SOCKS5 proxy and inspect supported protocols in real time. With InterceptSuite, you can: - **Intercept TLS/SSL:** Decrypt and inspect encrypted connections using MITM. - **Inspect multiple protocols:** Work with TCP, UDP, STARTTLS, DTLS, QUIC, and custom protocols. - **Modify traffic live:** Edit requests and responses before forwarding them. - **Analyze and replay:** Inspect traffic and replay captured data during testing. - **Automate workflows:** Use scripting to customize traffic handling and analysis. **ProxyBridge gets the traffic to the proxy. InterceptSuite gives you the tools to inspect and work with it.** [**Start your free trial — no credit card required →**](https://interceptsuite.com) ## License MIT License - See LICENSE file for details ## Author Sourav Kalal ([X](https://x.com/Ano_F_), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sourav-kalal/)) / InterceptSuite ([X](https://x.com/InterceptSuite), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/interceptsuite/)) ## Credits **Windows Implementation:** This project is built on top of [WinDivert](https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html) by basil00. WinDivert is a powerful Windows packet capture and manipulation library that makes kernel-level packet interception possible. Special thanks to the WinDivert project for providing such a robust foundation. Based on the StreamDump example from WinDivert: https://reqrypt.org/samples/streamdump.html The Windows GUI and CLI are written in native C using the Win32 API, keeping the footprint small and startup instant. **macOS Implementation:** Built using Apple's Network Extension framework for transparent proxy capabilities on macOS. **Linux Implementation:** Built on eBPF with a GTK3 GUI. See [Linux/README.md](Linux/README.md). **iOS Implementation:** Built on a Network Extension packet tunnel. The packet stack that turns the device's packets into TCP connections and UDP flows is [hev-socks5-tunnel](https://github.com/heiher/hev-socks5-tunnel) by heiher (MIT licence), which includes lwIP and other open-source libraries. Special thanks to the hev-socks5-tunnel project. See [iOS/README.md](iOS/README.md). **Android Implementation:** Built on the Android `VpnService`. The packet stack that turns the device's packets into TCP connections and UDP flows is [hev-socks5-tunnel](https://github.com/heiher/hev-socks5-tunnel) by heiher (MIT licence), which includes lwIP and other open-source libraries. Special thanks to the hev-socks5-tunnel project. See [Android/README.md](Android/README.md).
readmeHtml:
ProxyBridge

 

ProxyBridge is a free, open-source proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android. It forces the applications you choose to use a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy for their TCP and UDP traffic, even apps with no proxy settings or that ignore them, with no changes to the app.

Tip

ProxyBridge routes your traffic - InterceptSuite lets you see inside it. Full MITM proxy with SSL/TLS inspection, live request editing, scripting, and support for TCP, UDP, StartTLS, DTLS, QUIC and more. Built by the same team. Try InterceptSuite →

Table of Contents

  • Download
  • Features
  • Screenshots
  • Inspect redirected traffic with InterceptSuite
  • License
  • Author
  • Credits

💖 Support ProxyBridge Development
If you find ProxyBridge useful, consider sponsoring to support ongoing development and new features!

Download

Download ProxyBridge
Windows x64 · macOS (x64 & arm64) · Linux (x64 & ARM64)

The Android app is in closed testing on Google Play. To get access, join the ProxyBridge testers group with the Google account you use on your phone, then install the app from Google Play. You can also build it from source, see Android.

The iOS app is still in testing, so there is no public release for it yet. You can build it from source, see iOS.

Older versions

Caution

Beware of fake ProxyBridge downloads. Some unofficial sites distribute malware under the ProxyBridge name. Download only from this repository or interceptsuite.com/download/proxybridge, or build from source. ProxyBridge contacts no server except its update feed (download.interceptsuite.com/proxybridge.json), on launch or when you check for updates.

Features

  • Per-process routing - send traffic from chosen applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, or direct, or block it
  • Works with proxy-unaware apps - system-level interception, no changes to the application
  • TCP and UDP - HTTP/HTTPS, HTTP/3, SSH, RDP, databases, games, DTLS, DNS and more
  • Flexible rules - match processes, IPs, ports, protocols and host names, with wildcards and IPv4/IPv6
  • GUI and CLI on Windows, macOS and Linux, with profiles and rule import/export
  • iOS and Android apps - route a phone's traffic through a proxy by destination: domain, IP or CIDR, port and protocol

Screenshots

  • macOS screenshots
  • Windows screenshots
  • Linux screenshots
  • iOS screenshots
  • Android screenshots

Inspect redirected traffic with InterceptSuite

InterceptSuite is a cross-platform MITM proxy for inspecting, intercepting, and modifying network traffic. Use ProxyBridge to redirect application or system traffic to InterceptSuite's SOCKS5 proxy and inspect supported protocols in real time.

With InterceptSuite, you can:

  • Intercept TLS/SSL: Decrypt and inspect encrypted connections using MITM.
  • Inspect multiple protocols: Work with TCP, UDP, STARTTLS, DTLS, QUIC, and custom protocols.
  • Modify traffic live: Edit requests and responses before forwarding them.
  • Analyze and replay: Inspect traffic and replay captured data during testing.
  • Automate workflows: Use scripting to customize traffic handling and analysis.

ProxyBridge gets the traffic to the proxy. InterceptSuite gives you the tools to inspect and work with it.

Start your free trial — no credit card required →

License

MIT License - See LICENSE file for details

Author

Sourav Kalal (X, LinkedIn) / InterceptSuite (X, LinkedIn)

Credits

Windows Implementation: This project is built on top of WinDivert by basil00. WinDivert is a powerful Windows packet capture and manipulation library that makes kernel-level packet interception possible. Special thanks to the WinDivert project for providing such a robust foundation.

Based on the StreamDump example from WinDivert: https://reqrypt.org/samples/streamdump.html

The Windows GUI and CLI are written in native C using the Win32 API, keeping the footprint small and startup instant.

macOS Implementation: Built using Apple's Network Extension framework for transparent proxy capabilities on macOS.

Linux Implementation: Built on eBPF with a GTK3 GUI. See Linux/README.md.

iOS Implementation: Built on a Network Extension packet tunnel. The packet stack that turns the device's packets into TCP connections and UDP flows is hev-socks5-tunnel by heiher (MIT licence), which includes lwIP and other open-source libraries. Special thanks to the hev-socks5-tunnel project. See iOS/README.md.

Android Implementation: Built on the Android VpnService. The packet stack that turns the device's packets into TCP connections and UDP flows is hev-socks5-tunnel by heiher (MIT licence), which includes lwIP and other open-source libraries. Special thanks to the hev-socks5-tunnel project. See Android/README.md.

releases.name: v4.1.3_Macos
releases.body:
## ProxyBridge macOS 4.1.3

### New
- **Default proxy.** One proxy is the default, marked with a star in Proxy Settings. Rules can use **Default**, so changing the star moves all of those rules to another proxy at once. It is saved in each profile.

### Fixed
- Rules can now match a program by its full path, for example `/Applications/Google Chrome.app/*` (#288).

releases.name: v4.0.1_Linux
releases.body:
## 🐧 ProxyBridge Linux 4.0.1

### 🐛 Fixes

releases.name: v4.1.2_MacOS
releases.body:
## ProxyBridge macOS 4.1.2

### Fixed
- **Tunnel that does not start (#282).** On some Macs macOS stopped the tunnel right after starting it and ProxyBridge showed nothing. Now:
  - The Activity Logs say the tunnel did not start and show the reason macOS gave.
  - ProxyBridge tries once to repair it: it removes its saved network configuration and creates a new one. macOS may ask you to allow it again.
  - If that does not work, the log lists the steps to do by hand.
- **Command line:** the profile's Enable DNS setting is now applied before the tunnel starts. Before, a DNS proxy that was meant to be off could stay on when the tunnel failed to start. The command line also reports why the tunnel did not start and retries once with a fresh configuration.

### Added
- The extension now records why it started and stopped, for example `Tunnel stopping: stopped by the user`. It never records passwords or the addresses you connect to. To read it:
  `log show --last 10m --predicate 'subsystem == "com.interceptsuite.ProxyBridge.extension"'`
  Useful when you report a problem.

releases.name: v4.1.1_MacOS
releases.body:
## ProxyBridge macOS 4.1.1

### New
- **Enable DNS** in the Proxy menu (#275). It is on by default and saved per profile. Turn it off if another tool, such as Proxifier or a VPN, needs macOS's one DNS proxy. Routing keeps working. Rules with host names stop matching, and proxies get IP addresses 

### Fixed
- A proxy that refused a connection could make Chrome and Electron apps fail with a reset instead of trying IPv4 (#276). The connection now fails properly, so the app moves on to the next address.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A network tool that seamlessly bridges non-proxy-aware applications into interception proxies like Burp Suite or ZAP.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: ProxyBridge solves a common problem in security testing by intercepting traffic from thick clients, mobile apps, or command-line tools that ignore system proxy settings or use custom protocols. It works by setting up transparent local listeners or utilizing VPN interfaces to forcefully route an application's outbound traffic through an interception proxy like Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP. By handling the complex routing and protocol wrapping transparently, ProxyBridge allows security researchers to inspect and modify traffic that would otherwise bypass traditional HTTP proxies. It acts as an essential intermediary layer between stubborn client applications and standard web security analysis tools.
keyFeatures: Transparent proxying: Intercepts traffic without requiring application-level proxy configuration.
Protocol wrapping: Handles raw TCP/UDP traffic and wraps it for HTTP proxy inspection.
Thick client support: Captures traffic from desktop applications that ignore system proxy settings.
SSL/TLS manipulation: Integrates with interception proxies to facilitate certificate spoofing and decryption.
Cross-platform compatibility: Supports routing traffic on Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
VPN mode: Uses tun/tap interfaces to capture all traffic from a device or specific application.

useCases.title: Thick client penetration testing
useCases.description: Security consultants intercept and modify custom TCP traffic generated by enterprise desktop applications.

useCases.title: Mobile app security analysis
useCases.description: Researchers capture traffic from mobile applications that utilize certificate pinning or custom non-HTTP protocols.

useCases.title: Malware analysis
useCases.description: Analysts route malicious communication through a proxy to inspect command-and-control (C2) traffic safely.

useCases.title: IoT device testing
useCases.description: Engineers intercept hardware communication by routing the device's network traffic through the bridge.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: ProxyBridge is designed for penetration testers, security researchers, and network analysts who need to inspect non-standard or stubborn network traffic. It requires a strong understanding of networking protocols, routing, and interception proxies like Burp Suite.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Download the release binary and run: ./proxybridge --listen 8080 --forward 127.0.0.1:8081
